title: Robustness of Text-Only Adapted Speech LLMs for Spoken Semantic Parsing
abstract: arXiv:2606.21453v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate structured outputs from natural language instructions, including semantic frames and function calls. When the input is speech, this task becomes spoken semantic parsing, which can be performed using either Speech LLMs or ASR-LLM cascades. Although both approaches can be adapted with text-only task supervision, their relative robustness to acoustic degradation remains unclear. We compare these approaches under matched text-form supervision using 3B and 7B models across three datasets, evaluated on clean speech and babble noise at five SNR levels. Results show that Speech LLMs generally achieve better performance in command understanding, intent prediction, and function calling, particularly under severe noise, while improvements in fine-grained entity prediction are less consistent. An additional evaluation shows that Speech LLMs achieve lower average inference time

translated_title: 仅用文本适配的语音大语言模型在口语语义解析任务中的鲁棒性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型越来越多地被用于根据自然语言指令生成结构化输出，包括语义框架和函数调用。当输入为语音时，该任务就变成了口语语义解析，可以通过语音大语言模型或 ASR-LLM 级联系统来实现。尽管两种方法都可以仅通过文本形式的任务监督进行适配，但它们对声学退化的相对鲁棒性仍不明确。我们在匹配的文本形式监督条件下，使用 3B 和 7B 模型在三个数据集上对这两种方法进行了比较，并在干净语音以及五个信噪比水平的嘈杂噪声环境下进行评估。结果表明，语音大语言模型在命令理解、意图预测和函数调用方面通常表现更好，尤其是在严重噪声条件下，而在细粒度实体预测方面的改进则不太一致。额外的评估显示，语音大语言模型具有更低的平均推理时间。
tldr: 本研究对比了语音大语言模型与 ASR-LLM 级联系统在口语语义解析中的鲁棒性，发现语音大语言模型在噪声环境下于命令理解、意图预测和函数调用方面表现更优且推理时间更短。
en_tdlr: This study compares Speech LLMs with ASR-LLM cascades for spoken semantic parsing, showing that Speech LLMs achieve better robustness in command understanding, intent prediction, and function calling under noise, along with lower inference time.
